preMatch.sceneSetter: Brazil and Scotland step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: The World Cup returns to Europe for the first time since Italy hosted twelve years earlier. Thirty-two nations have arrived, and the tournament opens beneath the shadow of the Stade de France.
preMatch.inTheTournament: Nothing has happened yet. Thirty-two teams begin level across eight groups, and every prediction is still only a prediction.
preMatch.whyItMatters: Brazil arrive as defending champions and one of the tournament's most feared sides. Scotland return to the World Cup with experience and ambition. The opening match sets the tone for a competition expanding to thirty-two nations for the first time.

preMatch.whyItMatters: The Netherlands bring attacking talent and the frustration of never quite fulfilling their potential on the biggest stage. Argentina bring individual brilliance and the confidence of having survived a penalty shootout. Both teams believe they belong in the semifinals.

postMatch.goal: Patrick Kluivert 12′; Roberto Ayala 36′; Dennis Bergkamp 89′
postMatch.matchReport: Kluivert gave the Netherlands an early lead. Ayala equalized before halftime. Bergkamp scored a late winner to send the Netherlands through.

keyMoments.title: Kluivert gave the Netherlands an early lead

playersWhoShapedTheMatch.description: Scored one of the tournament's most memorable goals in the closing stages.

preMatch.sceneSetter: Germany and Croatia step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: Lyon hosts a quarterfinal that pits European experience against the rising force of Croatian football.
preMatch.inTheTournament: Germany controlled their group and eliminated Mexico professionally. Croatia arrive with the confidence of having beaten Romania with a moment of individual brilliance.
preMatch.whyItMatters: Germany bring the expectation that comes with being one of Europe's most successful nations. Croatia bring technical quality and the fearlessness of a team that believes it belongs among the world's best. The gap in history may be wide; the gap in current form may be less so.

postMatch.goal: Robert Jarni 45′; Goran Vlaović 46′; Zvonimir Boban 85′
postMatch.matchReport: Croatia scored three times in a stunning upset. Jarni opened the scoring on the stroke of halftime. Vlaović and Boban sealed one of the tournament's biggest surprises.

keyMoments.title: Croatia scored three times in a stunning upset
Jarni opened the scoring on the stroke of halftime

playersWhoShapedTheMatch.description: Scored immediately after halftime and killed German hopes.

Sealed the result and completed Croatia's statement.

preMatch.sceneSetter: Brazil and Netherlands step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: The semifinals begin as four teams remain and every player is now one match from the final.
preMatch.inTheTournament: Brazil and the Netherlands have both survived dramatic knockout ties. Now one advances to the final while the other faces the pain of falling one step short.
preMatch.whyItMatters: Brazil bring the individual quality that makes them favorites to retain their title. The Netherlands bring attacking talent and the belief that this may finally be their moment. Semifinals can be cautious until one moment alters the emotional balance.

postMatch.matchReport: Ronaldo gave Brazil the lead shortly after halftime. Kluivert equalized late in regulation. Brazil won the penalty shootout 4–2.

playersWhoShapedTheMatch.description: Scored after halftime and looked like the player Brazil needed.
Scored a crucial late goal to force extra time.
Saved penalties and sent Brazil to the final.

preMatch.sceneSetter: France and Croatia step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: The host nation's semifinal arrives as an entire country gathers to see whether the dream can reach the final.
preMatch.inTheTournament: France survived Italy on penalties in the quarterfinals. Croatia arrive after stunning Germany and announcing themselves as one of the tournament's most dangerous teams.
preMatch.whyItMatters: France carry the weight of a nation's expectations into the biggest match of their campaign so far. Croatia bring technical quality and the confidence of having eliminated Germany. The host nation knows that defeat here would feel like the end of a dream.

postMatch.matchReport: Šuker gave Croatia a second-half lead. Thuram scored twice to send the host nation to the final. France's dream remained alive.

keyMoments.title: Šuker gave Croatia a second-half lead
Thuram scored twice to send the host nation to the final

playersWhoShapedTheMatch.description: Scored both French goals in the most important match of his career.

preMatch.sceneSetter: Netherlands and Croatia step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: One match remains before the final, but this game has its own meaning for two teams closing memorable campaigns.
preMatch.inTheTournament: The Netherlands and Croatia meet for third place after falling one step short of the final.
preMatch.whyItMatters: The emotional challenge is unusual: both teams must recover quickly from semifinal disappointment and find a reason to finish strongly. These matches can become open because the fear of elimination has already passed.

postMatch.goal: Robert Prosinečki 14′; Patrick Kluivert 16′; Zvonimir Boban 36′; Davor Šuker 77′
postMatch.matchReport: Prosinečki opened the scoring before Kluivert equalized. Boban restored Croatia's lead before halftime. Šuker sealed Croatia's third-place finish in the second half.

preMatch.sceneSetter: Brazil and France step into a French World Cup night with the crowd gathering around them.
preMatch.aroundTheWorld: After one month, the tournament reaches its final match at the Stade de France.
preMatch.inTheTournament: Brazil and the host nation are the last two teams standing. Everything before this has led to one final afternoon.
preMatch.whyItMatters: Both nations understand this stage and the weight attached to it. Brazil arrive as defending champions seeking to retain their title on foreign soil. France carry the dreams of a host nation that has progressed steadily toward this moment. There is no next match.

postMatch.matchReport: Zidane scored twice from headers before halftime. Petit added a third in stoppage time. The host nation won the World Cup on home soil.
